versions.changelog:
Employee Onboarding Generator v1.0.0 — initial release

- Generate a structured 90-day onboarding plan for any role, from pre-boarding to 90-day success metrics.
- Includes checklists for IT, HR, compliance, manager and buddy assignments, and measurable milestones.
- Outputs onboarding packages in Google Sheets, Notion, Markdown, Slack workflows, and email sequences.
- Framework ensures clear timelines, responsibilities, and manager/buddy support throughout onboarding.
- Focused on retention, productivity, and compliance tracking for any industry or work arrangement.
